name: COVID-19 Mexico Challenge
content: Problems and Purpose The "COVID-19 Mexico Challenge" aimed to identify the main challenges arising from the pandemic in order to link them to solutions proposed by citizens. Citizens register through an online platform to participate in registering challenges so that other users can collaborate in the design and proposal of solutions. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities The initiative was implemented by Mexico's Network of Technology Transfer Offices i(Red OTT México). Participant Recruitment and Selection The initiative is open to all citizens who are able to register on the online platform. Companies, think tanks, universities and other organizations can also register in the portal.
